Explore research across the genus *Delftia*. These live public database results are not limited to the Delftia Project.

## Research Growth by Year

Orange shows **PubMed publications**, blue shows **cumulative publications**, gray shows **genome assemblies first made public in ENA**, and yellow shows **cumulative genome assemblies** through each year. These counts cover all matching records in today's databases, not historical database snapshots or unique strains. Genome years use ENA's **first_public** date, never record update dates; assemblies without a valid first-public date are excluded from both genome lines. The current year is incomplete.

```{=html}
<section class="dashboard-panel" aria-label="Annual research growth">
  <p id="growth-chart-status" role="status">Live graphs require JavaScript. Browse the PubMed and ENA source links below.</p>
  <div id="growth-chart-controls" hidden>
    <fieldset class="dashboard-line-legend">
      <legend>Show lines</legend>
      <label><input type="checkbox" data-growth-series="publications" checked> <span class="growth-swatch growth-publications" aria-hidden="true"></span> Publications</label>
      <label><input type="checkbox" data-growth-series="cumulative-publications" checked> <span class="growth-swatch growth-cumulative-publications" aria-hidden="true"></span> Cumulative publications</label>
      <label><input type="checkbox" data-growth-series="genomes" checked> <span class="growth-swatch growth-genomes" aria-hidden="true"></span> Genomes</label>
      <label><input type="checkbox" data-growth-series="cumulative-genomes" checked> <span class="growth-swatch growth-cumulative-genomes growth-cumulative" aria-hidden="true"></span> Cumulative genomes</label>
    </fieldset>
    <p>Hover over or tap the graph to inspect a year. Use the year slider with the arrow keys to explore counts, or toggle lines above. Record filtering below does not change the graph.</p>
    <div class="dashboard-line-scroll">
      <svg id="growth-chart" class="dashboard-line-chart" viewBox="0 0 720 320" role="img" aria-label="Publications, cumulative publications, genomes, and cumulative genomes by year"></svg>
    </div>
    <label for="growth-chart-year">Inspect year</label>
    <input type="range" id="growth-chart-year" min="0" max="0" value="0">
    <p id="growth-chart-detail" class="dashboard-chart-detail" aria-live="polite"></p>
  </div>
</section>
```

## Research in Numbers {#research-in-numbers}

These interactive graphs cover **all matching database records**, not just the latest 10 below. Hover over or focus a bar to inspect its count; select it to browse the source records. The record filter above does not change these graphs.

### PubMed Articles per Year

Counts of articles matching **Delftia** in PubMed, retrieved through Europe PMC using **SRC:MED** (PubMed-indexed records only), grouped by publication year. The current year is incomplete; indexing and publication-date corrections can change counts.

[Browse Delftia articles on PubMed](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/?term=Delftia)

```{=html}
<section class="dashboard-panel" aria-label="PubMed articles per year">
  <label for="publications-chart-sort">Year order</label>
  <select id="publications-chart-sort" hidden>
    <option value="ascending">Oldest first</option>
    <option value="descending">Newest first</option>
  </select>
  <p id="publications-chart-status" role="status">Live graphs require JavaScript. Use the PubMed link above to browse articles.</p>
  <p id="publications-chart-detail" class="dashboard-chart-detail" aria-live="polite"></p>
  <ul id="publications-chart" class="dashboard-chart" aria-label="Article counts by publication year"></ul>
</section>
```

### Delftia Genome Assemblies by Species

Counts of all *Delftia* genome assembly records in ENA (genus taxonomy **80865**), grouped by scientific name. Assemblies are not necessarily unique strains or complete genomes. Date sorting uses the most recent record update for each species. This is a current database inventory, **not a release-year graph**: record update dates do not establish when a genome was first published.

```{=html}
<section class="dashboard-panel" aria-label="Genome assemblies by species">
  <label for="genomes-chart-sort">Species order</label>
  <select id="genomes-chart-sort" hidden>
    <option value="descending">Most assemblies first</option>
    <option value="ascending">Species name</option>
    <option value="newest">Most recently updated first</option>
    <option value="oldest">Least recently updated first</option>
  </select>
  <p id="genomes-chart-status" role="status">Live graphs require JavaScript. Use the ENA link below to browse assemblies.</p>
  <p id="genomes-chart-detail" class="dashboard-chart-detail" aria-live="polite"></p>
  <ul id="genomes-chart" class="dashboard-chart" aria-label="Assembly counts by scientific name"></ul>
</section>
```

## Latest Publications {#latest-publications}

Up to 10 publications matching **Delftia**, newest publication date first, from Europe PMC. Database indexing can lag behind publication.

[Browse all Delftia publications on Europe PMC](https://europepmc.org/search?query=Delftia%20sort_date%3Ay)

::: {.dashboard-panel}
```{=html}
<p id="publications-status" role="status">Live publications require JavaScript. Use the source link above to browse the latest records.</p>
<ol id="publications-list" class="dashboard-list"></ol>
```
:::

## Latest Genomes {#latest-genomes}

Up to 10 *Delftia* genome assemblies from the European Nucleotide Archive (ENA), including assembly names, species and strains within the genus. Choose name order or newest/oldest record updates first. **Updated dates refer to database records, not necessarily new genome releases.**

[Browse Delftia genome assemblies on ENA](https://www.ebi.ac.uk/ena/browser/advanced-search?result=assembly&amp;query=tax_tree%2880865%29)

::: {.dashboard-panel}
```{=html}
<label for="genomes-sort">Assembly order</label>
<select id="genomes-sort" hidden>
  <option value="newest">Newest update first</option>
  <option value="oldest">Oldest update first</option>
  <option value="name">Assembly name</option>
</select>
<p id="genomes-status" role="status">Live genomes require JavaScript. Use the source link above to browse the latest records.</p>
<ol id="genomes-list" class="dashboard-list"></ol>
<script src="dashboard.js" defer></script>
```
:::
